name: Mono-Red Prowess
notes: 60-card casual mono-red prowess: cheap threats grow from a dense burn and flashback package. Looting finds threats and stocks the graveyard; Lava Dart and Reckless Charge provide repeat spell triggers. Burst Lightning gives the burn plan a late-game kicker outlet. Authored for FL-110; primitive support is not proof of useful bot sequencing. Measured with cmd/keywordbench, not added to the closed golden rotation.
